# `code.raw.get`

Describe the raw bytes of a file

Metadata for the byte response served at this URL. Browsers and Range requests receive bytes with a sniffed content type; JSON and Markdown receive this descriptor. Full-oid revisions are immutable.

- Method and path: `GET /{owner}/{repo}/raw/{rev}/{path...}`
- Scope: `public:read`
- Kind: `read`
- CLI: `rukie code raw get`
- MCP: `code_raw_get`
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `download` | query | no | `string` |
| `owner` | path | yes | `string` |
| `path` | path | yes | `string` |
| `repo` | path | yes | `string` |
| `rev` | path | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`forbidden`, `invalid`, `not-found`, plus the framework problems.
